## Bug Reports

Bug reports are accepted for reproducible behaviour which contravenes the documented behaviour. Anything else is either a support or a feature request.

Please check the open _and closed_ Issues and Pull Requests tabs for similar issues.

Select the **bug** issue type and fill in all the fields. Misfiled or partial reports may be closed as invalid.

If you are affected by an existing issue, do not comment “Me too” or “+1” on an existing issue; it makes it hard to follow the conversation surrounding an issue. Instead, put a “thumbs up” reaction in the issue description.

## Feature Requests

Please check the open _and closed_ Issues and Pull Requests tabs for similar issues.

When requesting a feature, please keep in mind that the final decision lies with the maintainers. We take into account whether it fits our design goals, whether it adversely impacts our users, the time commitment it generates for implementation _and ongoing maintenance_, and any security impact. We do not have an obligation to explain ourselves when we reject a feature request. We reserve the right to reject a previously accepted feature request if our exploration before or during the implementation surfaces a problem or factor we had previously missed. 

## Pull Requests

All contributors are understood to agree with the [Developer Certificate of Origin (DCO)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Developer_Certificate_of_Origin) statement, indicating their explicit agreement by signing off their contribution. If you disagree with the DCO we can regrettably not accept your contribution.

Submitting a Pull Request does not generate an obligation on the part of the maintainers to accept it or provide their reasoning for rejecting it. The same context as “Feature Requests” applies to Pull Requests.

## Translations

We write the English language files by hand. All other languages are machine-translated against a glossary.

If you find that the terms used are incorrect, please submit a Pull Request correcting the glossary – _not_ the machine-translated language file itself, as this will get overwritten.

If you want to see the software translated in a different language, please do tell us. We will explore the feasibility within the confines of what our generative AI-based translation software can do.
